name: @tanaka-takuto/crosslink
description: Track explicit consistency checks across related files

scripts.test: pnpm build && vitest run && node --test script/check-staged.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check:release && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm self:check
scripts.test:binary: pnpm build:binary && tsc --noEmit -p script/tsconfig.binary.json && vitest run --config script/vitest.binary.config.ts
scripts.check:release: tsc -p script/tsconfig.release.json && oxlint --deny-warnings script/check-version.ts script/check-version.test.ts script/release.ts script/release.test.ts script/vitest.config.ts && pnpm test:release
